**Report from Table 3:**

At our table, we found Q5.1 challenging because it requires balancing fairness with accuracy—a trade-off that's hard to quantify without concrete examples. We also struggled with Q7.1 and Q7.2 due to concerns about privacy and ensuring personalized messages don’t overwhelm students.

The most important questions for design were **Q5.1** (fairness vs. accuracy) and **Q6.1 & Q7.2** (intervention type and selectivity). We noticed divergence on how selective the model should be, with some prioritizing privacy and student well-being over broader reach.

Our table also discussed allowing students to opt in or choose outreach frequency—something not covered in the survey but crucial for tailoring support to individual needs.
